newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - Russian well supplied.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - Russian well supplied.

text.p: Russian high sulphur straight run fuel supplies continued unabated with no firm details yet on a possible export tariff.
"It's steady, there's no sign of a decrease in supplies," said one trader. Russian material was still overhanging the cracked market with potential to enter into the bunker sector.
E-4 prices were firm around $132 cif NWE.

Low sulphur straight run was tight with sellers unwilling to go below $140 fob NWE. A deal was rumoured done in the low $140s, but not confirmed."Buyers may be looking for this at cif numbers, but no chance," said one dealer.
